name: Mitsubishi A6M Zero
description: The Mitsubishi A6M 'Zero' was a long-range carrier-capable fighter aircraft operated by the Imperial Japanese Navy from 1940 to 1945. At the start of World War II it combined excellent maneuverability, long range and strong firepower, making it one of the most formidable naval fighters of the era. It remained in widespread use throughout the Pacific campaign and was produced in greater numbers than any other Japanese combat aircraft.
